column11: JUDGEMENT: no registrational study is registered. The Phase I/II (NCT06270316) reaches primary completion on 2027-12-01 on the registry (checked 2026-10-28). The nearest precedent in the disease is Sangamo's ST-920, a liver-directed AAV for Fabry disease that PTC bought in September 2026 with an $80mm milestone on 'accelerated approval by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (the FDA) of a biologics license application (BLA) for ST-920 for the treatment of Fabry disease based on the Company's Phase 1/2 STAAR study' (Sangamo 8-K 0001193125-26-374328), so a Phase I/II can carry a Fabry BLA. AMT-191 on that route: data at 2027-12, a dose chosen and an expansion cohort through 2028 to 2029, a BLA in 2030 under priority review (six months after a 60-day filing period, data/fda_review_clock.csv), and 2031 the first full year
column12: the case for later: 'additional dosing in the mid- and high-dose cohorts has been paused pending further evaluation following asymptomatic Grade 3 liver enzyme elevations observed in two patients in the mid-dose cohort, which were confirmed dose-limiting toxicity' (Q2 2026 10-Q, 0001104659-26-087815), so the dose is not settled. The case for earlier: ST-920's route straight from the Phase I/II data
